verdict.rationale: The UK IPO is a government service, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server, API, or agent connector. The documented surfaces are gov.uk guidance pages, online and paper filing, and a trade-mark search host whose robots.txt walls keyless agents.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
